items.difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-shriek, for f : X -> Y a morphism of FTS_S and K a dualizing complex on Y, with D_Y(M) = RSheafHom_{O_Y}(M, K) and D_X(E) = RSheafHom_{O_X}(E, f^!K), the lemma asserts a canonical isomorphism f^!M -> D_X(Lf^*D_Y(M)) for M in D^+_Coh(O_Y) (statement lines 4733-4746). The proof chooses a compactification j : X -> Xbar of X over Y by More on Flatness, Theorem labelled flat-theorem-nagata and Lemma labelled flat-lemma-compactifyable, lets a be the right adjoint of Lemma labelled lemma-twisted-inverse-image for Xbar -> Y and sets D_Xbar(E) = RSheafHom(E, a(K)), and observes that since formation of RSheafHom commutes with restriction to opens and f^! = j^* o a, it suffices to prove the same statement for a and D_Xbar (proof lines 4748-4760). The proof then computes, for F in D_QCoh(O_X), the Hom group into D_Xbar(L fbar^* D_Y(M)) by a seven term chain: internal Hom, the definition of a, the base change formula of Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-cohomology-base-change, internal Hom together with the definition of D_Y, the duality lemma Lemma labelled lemma-dualizing-schemes applied as D_Y(D_Y(M)) = M, and finally the definition of a again, obtaining Hom_Xbar(F, a(M)) (proof lines 4762-4793). Yoneda's lemma then gives the isomorphism (proof lines 4793-4795). Recognising that the chain of Hom computations is natural in F and reduces the claim to an application of the duality involution is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
